our_interpretation: The plain reading is a limited overall improvement on the complete question set, with fewer plainly nonsensical responses, some corrected failures, and some newly incorrect answers.
The surrounding discussion supplies Alexander’s six-question comparison as the reference for expectations. It does not supply a numerical threshold for modest improvement.
The target is the comparison newly reported around the post date. I use June 1–7, 2022 for this early-June observation; the earlier GPT-3 answers serve as its historical baseline.
Backsliding means an earlier correct response becoming incorrect on the same question. It does not by itself establish a decline in the model’s average capability.
criteria.support_condition: An admissible comparison covering the complete question set shows a limited aggregate improvement, fewer plainly nonsensical answers, at least one corrected earlier failure, and at least one earlier success becoming incorrect.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An admissible complete-set comparison shows a clearly large aggregate improvement under consistent scoring, or establishes that one of the claimed directional changes did not occur.
